    ∃ node,

              RearmBarrier.heapIndex cfg.cluster c.path ∧
            rmw.amount = c.mergeAmount ∧

                  (∃ f,
                      RearmBarrier.Tree.Preserves f ∧
                        t' =
                          RearmBarrier.Tree.modifyAt f t
                            c.path) ∧
                    (∃ node',
                        t'.get c.path = some node' ∧
                          node'.lo = node.lo ∧
                            node'.hi = node.hi ∧

                                        c.mergeAmount =
                                      node.size →

                      (next = RearmBarrier.Next.finished ↔

                              node.size) ∧

                            next =
                                RearmBarrier.Next.continue
                                  c' →
                              c' =
                                  { path := c.path.dropLast,
